edition: Unofficial Zork Cross-System Utility Mesh Glulx
player_outcomes: the existing rope can cinch the existing brown sack and turn short authored vertical geography into a reusable cargo line rather than another bespoke puzzle token
a loaded sack can be hauled from Studio to Kitchen through the chimney while the adventurer carries only the lamp and free rope end
the tree becomes a reversible ten-foot cargo route: leave the sack on the path, climb with the free line, haul it into the branches, or lower it again
an unlocked and open forest grating becomes reversible freight infrastructure; closing the grate physically blocks lowering or hauling through it
the material sack cinch and canonical Dome Room railing now compose instead of competing, allowing a secured sack to be lowered to the Torch Room while preserving canonical rope descent
a taut line to remote cargo constrains wandering: the adventurer must haul the sack or return along the active vertical run
boundaries: no object-pair or noun-triple recipe matrix; one cargo capability composes with a small resolver of already-authored vertical geography
no new rope-state global: the cargo end reuses MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR and MATERIAL-SACK-CINCHED while the Dome fixed end remains canonical DOME-FLAG authority
canonical Dome rope handling remains authoritative; material rope handling explicitly yields the railing interaction back to ROPE-FUNCTION
the mine shaft keeps its purpose-built basket and chain; Release 1251 does not duplicate machinery that already exists
Dam top-to-base is not treated as a rope span because current world text does not establish this rope as long enough for the looming dam
the rainbow is not an anchor and the White Cliffs gain no magical rope route without authored physical support
no automatic puzzle completion, score route, universal physics simulator, crafting system, debug shortcut, or recursive audit machinery
